Order on Criminal Misc. Amendment Application No. 02/2025
Learned counsel for petitioner is directed to carry out necessary amendment in the writ petition within course of the day.
Amendment application is allowed.
Order on Criminal Misc. Modification Application No.3/2025

The order dated 05.03.2025 has been sought to be modified on the ground that the petitioner was implicated under section 409 IPC in Hasmad @ Hasmat And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 11 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46552939/
1 place of 406 IPC at the time of order aforesaid.

entities.text: Hasmad @ Hasmat And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned
AGA on the basis of instructions submits that the contention made in the modification application is correct.

Accordingly, the order dated 05.03.2025 is replaced by following order:-
"Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned AGA for State.

The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned First Information FIR dated 08.03.2022 lodged in Case Crime No.0101 of 2022,
under Sections- 420, 406, 506 IPC, Police Station - Cantt. Varanasi Commissionerate, District Varanasi, and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioner in pursuance of impugned First Information Report.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the informant is agent of the finance company which is alleged to havesiphoned of the amount invested in the company of petitioners to another company.

entities.text: Police Station - Cantt. Varanasi Commissionerate, District Varanasi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He has further submitted that the petitioners have worked in the company from 2011 to 2015 only.
They are neither director nor holding any responsible post therein.
They have been falsely implicated by the agent of the company.
Matter requires consideration.
Issue notice to respondent no. 3.
Steps be taken within a week.
All the respondents may file counter affidavits within period of four weeks.
Petitioner may file rejoinder affidavit within two weeks.
List this case after six weeks.

Till the next date of listing or till cognizance is taken by court on police report submitted under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C.,/193(3) B.N.S.S., the respondents are restrained from arresting the petitioners pursuant to the First Information Report,
subject to cooperation in ongoing investigation."
Modification application is allowed.
